name: Hyphal Advance
effect: GLOBAL. Release the network: every tip runs one growth pulse toward sensed food. Unplayable if no attractor is in sensing range.
flavor: The default hunger of a colony: reach, always, toward the next meal.

name: Radial Flush
effect: GLOBAL. Grow 1 short segment in EVERY direction from every tip, ignoring attractors. Fills a pocket and seeds branches to steer later.
flavor: Marasmius throwing a fairy ring outward in every bearing at once.

name: Tropic Lunge
effect: DIRECTIONAL. Aim a straight-line growth burst of 3 segments in a chosen compass direction, ignoring attractors. Punches toward terrain you can't yet sense.
flavor: Positive tropism — the tip commits to a bearing and drives.

name: Forage Seek
effect: GLOBAL. Grow 3 segments toward the NEAREST food source anywhere on the map, even if out of sensing range. Unplayable if no food remains.
flavor: Chemotropism across the dark — the colony always knows where the larder is.

name: Leaf-Litter Lure
effect: DIRECTIONAL. Drop a SMALL nutrient patch at the edge of sensing range in a chosen direction. Steers the next Grow; barely feeds.
flavor: A scatter of rotting leaf to tempt the frontier onward.

name: Burst Digest
effect: GLOBAL. Over-digest ALL occupied substrate at once for +1 Energy per occupied patch (flat). Depletes those patches faster than passive income would.
flavor: Cash the mat in now — autolysis for a quick meal.

name: Twig Bed
effect: DIRECTIONAL, cooldown 2. Drop a MEDIUM nutrient patch at the edge of sensing range in a chosen direction — enough to lure and lightly feed a branch.
flavor: Woody debris: slower to rot, but it holds a frontier.

name: Log Cache
effect: DIRECTIONAL, one-shot. Drop a LARGE nutrient patch at the edge of sensing range in a chosen direction — a real pile that both lures and feeds a colonisation.
flavor: A whole fallen limb, buried and waiting — Xylaria's feast.

name: Buried Windfall
effect: DIRECTIONAL, one-shot. Drop a HUGE nutrient patch at the edge of sensing range in a chosen direction — bridges a barren stretch or bankrolls a late push.
flavor: The whole windthrown crown gone under — a season of food in one drop.

name: Guttation Sip
effect: DIRECTIONAL. Tap a lake edge in a chosen direction for +3 Water (drains one of the edge's ~3 charges). Unplayable if no lake edge is in range.
flavor: Hydnellum weeping clear droplets at dawn.

name: Mineral Etch
effect: DIRECTIONAL. Tap a mineral/crystal rock in a chosen direction for +3 Phosphorus (one of its ~3 charges). Unplayable if no mineral rock is in range.
flavor: Oxalic acid pitting the stone, prying phosphate loose.

name: Saprophagy
effect: GLOBAL. Scavenge decay across the network for +1 Nitrogen. The free floor when no worm is dead to digest.
flavor: Nitrogen wrung from whatever already died down here.

name: Rootlet Bore
effect: DIRECTIONAL. Clear ONE boulder (1-cell rock) in a chosen direction. Unplayable if no boulder is in range.
flavor: Acid-tipped rhizomorphs worrying a pebble out of the way.

name: Rhizomorph Pry
effect: DIRECTIONAL, cooldown 2. Clear ONE rock formation (the wide low crystal/ember/fungal masses) in a chosen direction. Unplayable if no formation is in range.
flavor: Armillaria's black bootlaces splitting a seam in the mass.

name: Serpula Creep
effect: DIRECTIONAL, cooldown 3. Clear ONE rock column (a full vertical barrier) in a chosen direction. Unplayable if no column is in range.
flavor: Dry rot conducts its own water and walks straight through masonry.

name: Basin Breach
effect: DIRECTIONAL, one-shot. Drain and clear the lake basin barrier in a chosen direction — opens the hardest crossing on the map. Unplayable if the basin is not in range.
flavor: Undermine the bowl and let the whole lake find the deep dark.

name: Universal Solvent
effect: DIRECTIONAL, one-shot. Clear ANY ONE rock in a chosen direction regardless of class — boulder, formation, column, or lake basin. Unplayable if no rock is in range.
flavor: Oxalic acid enough to eat anything the earth put in your way.

name: Rhizomorph Cord
effect: INSTALL. +2 Energy per round while the network is alive. The cheap, reliable trunk line.
flavor: Bundled hyphae as a pipeline, shuttling sugar from the far frontier home.
notes: Energy engine: 2/round. Repay ~5 rounds. Counts to <11 ceiling.

name: Xylaria Deadwood Bed
effect: INSTALL. +3 Energy per round, but only while you occupy at least 4 substrate patches (else +1). Rewards a broad, colonised mat.
flavor: Dead man's fingers, patiently rendering buried wood to sugar.
notes: Energy engine: up to 3/round, conditional. Repay ~5. Counts to <11 ceiling.

name: Sclerotial Battery
effect: INSTALL. +4 Energy per round for 6 rounds, then it exhausts to a spent husk (+0). A finite, front-loaded engine — burn it during a hard stretch.
flavor: A sclerotium spending its hoarded store, then going quiet.
notes: Energy engine: 4/round capped, self-exhausting. Repay ~4. Counts to <11 while live.

name: Fairy-Ring Metabolism
effect: INSTALL. +2 Energy per round, AND once every 3 rounds it also grows 1 omni-segment for free. A slow economy that also creeps.
flavor: The ring widens each year, feeding as it goes.
notes: Energy engine: 2/round (growth is exempt). Repay ~6. Counts to <11 ceiling.

name: Autolysis
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. Over-digest ALL occupied substrate for +2 Energy per patch (flat). Downside: leaves those patches near-empty, cutting passive income next round.
flavor: The colony eats its own stored mass in a rush.
notes: Ungated but real downside (income crash). Flat +2/patch.

name: Enzyme Bloom
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. +3 Energy per occupied patch (flat). Gated by Water — turgor drives the enzyme flush.
flavor: A pulse of cellulase across the whole mat at once.
notes: Gated => cheaper than Autolysis for a bigger flat rate.

name: Phosphate Fire
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. +4 Energy per occupied patch (flat). Gated by Phosphorus — ATP spent to redline metabolism.
flavor: Every mitochondrion in the mat opened wide for one heartbeat.
notes: Highest flat rate; heavy P gate keeps it honest.

name: Cordyceps Windfall
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. Gain +6 Energy for each dead nematode you have digested this run (flat, min +6). Gated by Nitrogen. Rewards a worm-heavy map.
flavor: The predator's fee, paid all at once.
notes: Scales with worm kills; useless-ish on worm-light maps => opportunity cost, not a dud.

name: Anastomosis
effect: INSTALL. Shuffle 3 new Hyphal Advance basics into your draw deck. Extends the clock; the extender itself is not recycled.
flavor: Hyphae fusing where they cross — the net rewires itself denser.

name: Chlamydospore Reserve
effect: INSTALL. Shuffle 2 Burst Digest and 1 Leaf-Litter Lure basic into your draw deck. Runway plus a little economy.
flavor: Thick-walled survival spores banked against the lean stretch.

name: Rhizomorph Highway
effect: INSTALL. Shuffle 3 Tropic Lunge basics into your draw deck. Runway tuned for punching across barren terrain.
flavor: Cord-conducting bundles laid down as express lanes.

name: Mycorrhizal Windfall
effect: INSTALL. Shuffle 5 assorted basics (2 grow, 1 substrate, 1 water tap, 1 mineral tap) into your draw deck. The big late-run runway refill.
flavor: A whole root-web of partners, suddenly plugged in.

name: Ghost-Fungus Lantern
effect: INSTALL. Widens sensing radius so attractors are found sooner, AND the FIRST draw each round costs 3 less Energy. Cheapens the clock without refilling it.
flavor: Panellus glow lighting the substrate two body-lengths further out.
notes: Draw-economy engine; does not print master currency (exempt from ceiling).

name: Woodwide Web
effect: INSTALL, cooldown 3. Next draw this round is FREE (0 Energy). A repeatable pressure valve on the energy-for-cards tax.
flavor: The common network sharing what one colony can't afford alone.

name: Osmotic Draught
effect: DIRECTIONAL, cooldown 1. Deep-tap a lake edge in a chosen direction for +6 Water at once (drains 2 charges). The Water harvest option. Unplayable if no lake edge in range.
flavor: Suillus drawing hard on the bog it grew beside.

name: Suillus Bog Mat
effect: INSTALL. +3 Water per round while any tip sits within sensing range of a lake; +1 otherwise. Your standing Water supply.
flavor: A bolete's felt drinking steadily from the waterline.
notes: Resource engine (exempt from energy ceiling). Repay in tempo.

name: Turgor Surge
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. Gated by Water. Every tip grows 2 segments toward sensed food AND branches denser — a turgor-pressure growth spike across the whole colony.
flavor: Cells swelling with water until the whole front lunges.

name: Aquaporin Gate
effect: INSTALL. Each round, one growth pulse toward sensed food is 40% longer reach (flat +2 segment length). Sustained traversal engine, Water-themed.
flavor: Water channels flung wide so the tip drives further per push.
notes: Growth engine (exempt). Repay in saved grow actions.

name: Hydraulic Lift
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 90). Gated by Water. Soften and clear every boulder within the radius at once, and lure growth into the cleared ground. Unplayable if no boulder in radius.
flavor: Redistributing night water to crack a field of stones.

name: Rehydration Bloom
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 100), cooldown 2. Gated by Water. Restore vitality to all strands in the radius and clear any drought/dip. General repair, Water-themed.
flavor: Parched hyphae plumping back to life as the water returns.

name: Oxalic Bore
effect: DIRECTIONAL, cooldown 1. Deep-etch a mineral rock in a chosen direction for +6 Phosphorus (2 charges). The Phosphorus harvest option. Unplayable if no mineral rock in range.
flavor: Crystals of calcium oxalate blooming where the acid bites deepest.

name: Glomus Arbuscule
effect: INSTALL. +2 Phosphorus per round while alive. The steady mycorrhizal P line.
flavor: Arbuscular hyphae branching inside a root, trading sugar for phosphate.
notes: Resource engine (exempt from energy ceiling).

name: Hartig Net
effect: INSTALL. +3 Phosphorus per round while you occupy at least 3 patches; +1 otherwise. The broad-colony P engine.
flavor: A lattice of hyphae sheathing every rootlet in reach.
notes: Resource engine (exempt). Gate keeps it off turn-one.

name: Prototaxites Spire
effect: INSTALL. Gated by Phosphorus. Each round, grow 1 aimed segment straight UP toward the surface — a standing structural push toward daylight.
flavor: The great primordial fungal tower, reaching for a sky that had no trees.
notes: Growth engine (exempt). Structure/reach theme.

name: Crystalline Trellis
effect: DIRECTIONAL, one-shot. Gated by Phosphorus. Lay a rigid mineralised growth spur: grow 5 segments in a straight chosen direction, passing over cleared ground. A hard structural reach.
flavor: Hyphae calcified into scaffolding to hold an impossible line.

name: Phosphate Foundry
effect: INSTALL. +2 Energy per round, but consumes 1 Phosphorus each round to run (idles at +0 if you have no P). Converts your P supply into master currency.
flavor: Burning stored phosphate for ATP when the sugar runs thin.
notes: ENERGY engine: 2/round, counts to <11 ceiling; self-limits via P cost.

name: Springtail Snare
effect: INSTALL. +2 Nitrogen per round from trapped soil fauna (springtails, mites) — useful even with no nematodes on the map. The unconditional N line.
flavor: Laccaria's adhesive hyphae, quietly harvesting the little animals.
notes: Resource engine (exempt). Unconditional: works without worms.

name: Decay Compost
effect: GLOBAL, cooldown 1. Wring +3 Nitrogen from network-wide decay at once. The N harvest option (no worm required).
flavor: Ammonia rising off everything the colony has already unmade.

name: Mycelial Bloom
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. Gated by Nitrogen. Every tip grows 2 segments toward sensed food and thickens — a nitrogen-fed surge, the aggression payoff.
flavor: The flush after rain, when nitrogen is suddenly cheap.

name: Chitin Armor
effect: INSTALL. Gated by Nitrogen. +50% vitality recovery each round network-wide and a standing resistance to all threats' first touch. The N defensive payoff.
flavor: Melanised, chitin-thick walls that shrug off the first bite.
notes: Defense engine (exempt). Unconditional value even threat-free (recovery).

name: Nitrogen Foundry
effect: INSTALL. +2 Energy per round, but consumes 1 Nitrogen each round (idles at +0 with no N). Turns aggression payoff into master currency.
flavor: Deaminating amino acids for a steady drip of ATP.
notes: ENERGY engine: 2/round, counts to <11 ceiling; self-limits via N cost.

name: Cordyceps Lance
effect: DIRECTIONAL, one-shot. Gated by Nitrogen. A violent aimed growth strike of 6 segments straight in a chosen direction — the aggressive traversal spike.
flavor: The fruiting stalk that erupts from a host, driving skyward.

name: Ophiocordyceps Sentinel
effect: INSTALL. Each round, an infected ant scout wanders home and weakens its nest (small standing pressure on ant HP). ALSO widens the range at which food piles are revealed — useful even with no ants present.
flavor: The zombie-ant fungus, turning the raiders into its own scouts.
notes: Unconditional: the reveal helps route to food even ant-free.

name: Formic Ward
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 120), cooldown 2. Sever the ant trail and repel foragers within the radius, so a nest must re-path and you get a head start to the pile.
flavor: A reek of antibiotic hyphae the column refuses to cross.

name: Leafcutter's Due
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 110), one-shot. Rush-digest every food pile in the radius for +3 Energy per patch (flat) NOW — beat the ants to the harvest. Unplayable if no food in radius.
flavor: Take the leaf-hoard first; let the colony arrive to bare soil.

name: Myrmecophyte Pact
effect: INSTALL. +1 Energy per round; if any ant nest is active on the map, +3 instead. A pact that pays whether or not the ants show — never a dead draft.
flavor: Feeding the colony a sugar tithe so they raid a neighbour instead.
notes: ENERGY engine: capped 3/round, counts to <11 ceiling. Unconditional floor of +1.

name: Trail Choke
effect: DIRECTIONAL, cooldown 2. Grow a dense mycelial wall 2 segments in a chosen direction that ant trails cannot cross, walling a pile off from a nest.
flavor: A living palisade the foragers meet and turn back from.

name: Melanin Sheath
effect: INSTALL. Standing chance to RESIST each Trichoderma contact infection, and +vitality recovery each round. Useful as plain regeneration even with no mould about.
flavor: Melanised cell walls: sunscreen, armour, and a rot-shield in one.
notes: Defense engine (exempt). Unconditional recovery value.

name: Woronin Seal
effect: GLOBAL, cooldown 1. Plug the septal pores network-wide: FREEZE all rot spread for 1 round (the race along your filaments halts). Buys a turn to cut or cleanse.
flavor: Woronin bodies slamming the hyphal doors shut against the breach.

name: Penicillin Purge
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 110), cooldown 1. Cleanse ALL infection within the radius and kill any Trichoderma cloud caught inside it. The workhorse cleanse.
flavor: Penicillium doing what it has always done to a rival mould.

name: Antibiosis Field
effect: INSTALL. Each round, cleanse a little infection network-wide AND emit an antifungal aura that slows Trichoderma clouds approaching your frontier. Standing mould suppression.
flavor: A permanent chemical no-man's-land at the colony's edge.
notes: Even mould-free it keeps strands clean of transient dips.

name: Scorched Excision
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 130), one-shot. Amputate every strand in a LARGE radius and cleanse the ground — the emergency firebreak for a runaway infection. Regrow after.
flavor: Cut to living tissue and burn the rest; the colony can afford to lose an arm.

name: Arthrobotrys Ring-Net
effect: INSTALL. Constricting hyphal rings passively snare and digest nematodes near your frontier each round, yielding +1 Nitrogen per round even with no worms (soil fauna). Scales up when worms swarm.
flavor: The noose fungus, its rings snapping shut on anything that crawls through.
notes: Unconditional N floor; converts a worm map into a payoff. Resource engine (exempt).

name: Sticky Secretion
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 70). Secrete mucus: stick every nematode in a small radius for 1 round (no move/feed/breed). The free floor worm tool.
flavor: Adhesive knobs the worms blunder into and cannot leave.

name: Pleurotus Predation
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 100), one-shot. Toxic droplets paralyse and DIGEST every nematode in the radius, converting them to Nitrogen (~+2 N each). The worm->N payoff burst.
flavor: The oyster mushroom, quietly carnivorous, dissolving its prey for nitrogen.

name: Nematophagous Bed
effect: INSTALL. A standing carnivorous mat: each round it kills nematodes in contact and banks the Nitrogen (+2 N per worm digested). On a worm-heavy map this is a runaway N engine.
flavor: A whole hunting ground of hyphal traps, always set.
notes: Resource engine (exempt). Value scales with worm pressure; pairs with N lane.

name: Mucus Flood
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 140), cooldown 2. A wide sticky flood: stick every nematode in a LARGE radius for 2 rounds and halt a breeding swarm. The panic button.
flavor: Guttation turned to glue across the whole embattled front.

name: Sclerotium Bunker
effect: INSTALL. Standing +vitality recovery and a resistance to the FIRST hit from ants, mould, or worms each round. A hardened core that never sits idle whatever the map throws up.
flavor: A dense survival mass the colony can always retreat into.
notes: Unconditional (recovery). Defense engine (exempt).

name: Turkey-Tail Guard
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 120), cooldown 2. Immune surge: cleanse mould infection, repel ants, and stick worms in the radius, all at once. One button for a mixed assault.
flavor: Trametes' banded shelves, the classic immune tonic of the forest.

name: Amanita Toxin Ring
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 130), one-shot. Lay a toxic ring: kills nematodes and Trichoderma clouds and drives ant foragers out of the radius. The scorched-earth reset.
flavor: Muscarine and amatoxin — nothing that eats the colony survives the dose.

name: Pilobolus Cannon
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. Late-game only. Fire an aimed growth ballista of 8 segments straight toward the REVEALED goal zone, punching across open ground. Unplayable until the goal is sensed.
flavor: The hat-thrower, launching its cargo at ten thousand g toward the light.

name: Heliotropic Rush
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. Late-game only. Every tip within reach of the goal soil surges 4 segments toward it and branches to fill the fruiting columns. Unplayable until the goal is sensed.
flavor: The whole colony leaning at once toward the summer light.

name: Fruiting Primordia
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. Late-game only. Force fruiting-body primordia across ALL reachable goal soil at once, even sickly or shallow tissue — guarantees the fruit that wins the level if any goal soil is held. Unplayable if no goal soil is reached.
flavor: Pins forming in the dark, committing the colony's whole life to this one flush.

name: Rhizomorph Sprint
effect: DIRECTIONAL, one-shot. Late-game only. Lay an express cord 7 segments in a chosen direction and pull the whole frontier along it — a hard traversal finisher for the last barren gap.
flavor: Bootlaces racing through the dark, meters a day, straight for the exit.

name: Prospering Flush
effect: INSTALL. Late-game engine. Each round, grow 1 segment toward the revealed goal AND +1 Energy. Buy it once the goal is in sight to close the run on autopilot. Unplayable until the goal is sensed.
flavor: The colony, scenting summer, needs no more steering.
notes: ENERGY engine: 1/round (counts to <11). Growth exempt. Goal-locked.

name: Physarum Router
effect: INSTALL. Each round, auto-extend 1 segment toward the NEAREST sensed attractor (slime-mould pathfinding). Hands you steady routing without spending draws.
flavor: The slime mould that solves the maze and keeps only the efficient tubes.
notes: Growth engine (exempt from energy ceiling).

name: Split-Gill Spread
effect: GLOBAL, cooldown 1. Grow 1 omni-segment from every tip AND branch denser network-wide — resilient, desiccation-proof coverage on demand.
flavor: Schizophyllum commune: more mating types than any organism, everywhere at once.

name: Honey-Fungus March
effect: DIRECTIONAL, one-shot. Advance the entire frontier 4 segments in a chosen direction as a coordinated sheet — the biggest single aimed push before finishers.
flavor: Armillaria, the largest organism alive, walking the forest floor.

name: Truffle Instinct
effect: GLOBAL, cooldown 2. Reveal the nearest unsensed food pile AND grow 2 segments toward it. Anti-stall tool when the frontier can't find the next meal.
flavor: Tuber, buried and blind, yet unerring toward what feeds it.

name: Guttation Reservoir
effect: INSTALL. Store up to +2 extra Water soft-cap and refund 1 Water each round from condensation. A small standing top-up that smooths Water sequencing.
flavor: Dew beading on the hyphae each night, saved against the dry.
notes: Resource engine (exempt). Raises effective W cap slightly.

name: Bleeding-Tooth Font
effect: GLOBAL, cooldown 2. Guttate +4 Water from the network's own stored moisture — a Water harvest that needs no lake in range. The desert option.
flavor: Hydnellum peckii weeping its scarlet drops far from any pool.

name: Calcite Vault
effect: INSTALL. Store up to +2 extra Phosphorus soft-cap and refund 1 P each round from mineral scavenging. Smooths P sequencing for the heavy-gated cards.
flavor: Oxalate crystals banked in the hyphae like coin.
notes: Resource engine (exempt). Raises effective P cap slightly.

name: Bore-Tide
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 100), one-shot. Gated by Phosphorus. Clear every boulder AND every rock formation within the radius at once. Unplayable if none in radius.
flavor: Acid enough to dissolve a whole reef of stone in a night.

name: Diazotroph Symbiosis
effect: INSTALL. Host nitrogen-fixing bacteria: +2 Nitrogen per round from the air itself, unconditional. A second standing N line for aggression decks.
flavor: Bacteria lodged in the hyphae, spinning nitrogen out of nothing.
notes: Resource engine (exempt). Unconditional.

name: Lion's-Mane Regrowth
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 110), cooldown 2. Regenerate strands and rapidly re-grow tissue lost to any threat in the radius — restorative, not preventive. Pairs with any excision.
flavor: Hericium's cascading spines: the fungus that mends nerves mending itself.

name: Chitin Digest
effect: GLOBAL. Burst-digest ONLY the substrate under your densest, oldest mat for +2 Energy per such patch (flat). A focused floor burst; weaker than premium bursts, free to draw.
flavor: Recycling the colony's own thickened core for a quick meal.

name: Sensing Bloom
effect: GLOBAL. Flare the sensing radius for this action only: the next Grow this round sees attractors much further out. Free anti-stall floor tool.
flavor: A pulse of receptors flung out into the dark.

name: Melanize
effect: GLOBAL. Toughen cell walls for 1 round: standing chance to resist the next Trichoderma contact network-wide. The free floor mould tool.
flavor: Pigment flooding the walls the moment spores drift near.

name: Scout Repel
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 80). Emit a brief antibiotic reek that turns ant foragers back from the radius for 1 round. The free floor ant tool.
flavor: A whiff of something the column's chemists flag as poison.

name: Fissure Grow
effect: DIRECTIONAL. Grow 2 aimed segments in a chosen direction and, if they meet a boulder, clear it as they pass. Combines a small push with a small dig. Free floor tool.
flavor: Hyphae wedging into a crack until the pebble simply gives.

name: Turgor Tap
effect: GLOBAL. Gated by Water. Spend turgor for a single free growth pulse toward sensed food at no Energy — a cheap Water-fuelled tempo basic.
flavor: A short swell of pressure, spent on one honest push.

name: Necromass Feast
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. Gated by Nitrogen. Convert banked Nitrogen into a one-time +5 Energy per 2 N spent (you choose how much, up to your stock). Flexible late fuel.
flavor: The colony eating its own dead in a controlled, nitrogen-rich burn.

name: Mycangial Cache
effect: INSTALL. Shuffle 2 resource-tap basics (1 Guttation Sip, 1 Mineral Etch) into your draw deck. Runway that also shores up your W/P floor.
flavor: Beetles carry fungal spores in special pockets; the colony keeps its own.

name: Hyphal Fusion
effect: INSTALL, cooldown 4. Retrieve one spent basic from the graveyard back into your hand-side pile — the ONLY recycle in the game, deliberately rare and slow.
flavor: Two colonies touching, becoming one, sharing what each had lost.
notes: Slow, single-target, long cooldown: does not break the no-reshuffle clock.

name: Deep-Reach Taproot
effect: DIRECTIONAL, one-shot. Gated by Water. Dive a single strand deep and far: grow 6 aimed segments straight DOWN-and-across in a chosen direction, tunnelling beneath a barrier belt.
flavor: The one cord that goes deep enough to pass under everything.

name: Companion Planting
effect: INSTALL. +1 Energy per round, and +1 more per round for each OTHER resource engine (W/P/N) you have installed, capped at +4 total. Rewards a resource-engine build.
flavor: A guild of partners, each paying a little into the common purse.
notes: ENERGY engine: hard cap 4/round, counts to <11 ceiling.

name: Zombie Ant Vector
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. Turn an active ant nest against itself: it stops harvesting and its foragers clear a path (removes the impassable trail) for 3 rounds. Unplayable if no ant nest is active.
flavor: The fungus steers the colony's corpse to where its spores need to go.

name: Spore Print Draft
effect: INSTALL. Shuffle 2 Forage Seek and 1 Sensing Bloom basic into your draw deck. Runway tuned to keep a stalled frontier finding food.
flavor: A dark print dropped on the soil, each spore a fresh start.

name: Cellulase Cascade
effect: GLOBAL, cooldown 2. Digest all occupied substrate for +2 Energy per patch (flat), repeatable on cooldown. A metered burst engine, not a one-shot — the reliable mid-game refill.
flavor: The enzyme wave you can call up again and again, if you pace it.
notes: Action (cooldown-gated repeatable), not a standing energy engine => exempt from ceiling.

name: Mycorrhizal Handshake
effect: INSTALL. +3 Energy per round while at least one tip sits within sensing range of a food pile; +1 otherwise. Rewards keeping the frontier fed.
flavor: Sugar-for-mineral trade, humming only while a partner is in reach.
notes: ENERGY engine: up to 3/round, conditional, counts to <11 ceiling.

name: Amadou Tinder
effect: INSTALL. +1 Energy per round; consumes 0 resources. The tiniest, cheapest standing trickle — an early pick that never embarrasses you and frees draws for action.
flavor: Fomes tinder, catching the smallest spark and holding it.
notes: ENERGY engine: 1/round, counts to <11 ceiling. Cheap early runway.

name: Hydnellum Weir
effect: DIRECTIONAL, one-shot. Gated by Water. Clear one rock column in a chosen direction by dissolving its base — a Water-gated alternative to the P-gated column dig. Unplayable if no column in range.
flavor: Redirecting water to carve the barrier out from under itself.

name: Sporangial Volley
effect: DIRECTIONAL, cooldown 1. Fire 3 aimed segments in a chosen direction, repeatable — a cheap standing traversal tool for open ground once installed.
flavor: A steady patter of spores, each one a new advancing tip.

name: Colonise Pocket
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 90), cooldown 1. Densely branch and fully colonise all occupied substrate within the radius in one action — maximises passive income from a pile fast.
flavor: Saturating a food pocket with mat until every cell is worked.

name: Ambrosia Garden
effect: INSTALL. +2 Energy per round, but only while NO threat is currently touching your network; +0 while under attack. A fair-weather engine that pays in calm stretches.
flavor: Beetles farming their fungal gardens — productive only in peace.
notes: ENERGY engine: 2/round, conditional, counts to <11 ceiling.

name: Dead-Man's-Fingers Reach
effect: DIRECTIONAL, one-shot. Gated by Phosphorus. Grow 4 aimed segments straight down in a chosen direction through deep soil, then branch — the structural deep-dive to slip under a column belt.
flavor: Xylaria's black digits, reaching into wood no other fungus bothers with.

name: Immune Priming
effect: INSTALL. Each round, reduce the reach of the NEXT threat contact (rot rings claimed, worms fed, ants harvested) by a flat amount. A standing damage-cap on whatever hits first.
flavor: The colony that has been bitten once and remembers.
notes: Unconditional across all three threats; defense engine (exempt).

name: Guttation Cleanse
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 70). Rinse a small radius: stick worms AND wash off light mould infection at once. A dual free-floor cleanse for a messy frontier.
flavor: A flush of clean droplets carrying the grime away.

name: Sunlit Antennae
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. Late-game only. Permanently reveal the goal zone and its shaded columns, and grow 3 segments toward it. The scout that opens the endgame. Unplayable until you are within a few pushes of the goal.
flavor: The first hyphae to taste warm soil, and call the rest.

name: Overwinter Sclerotium
effect: INSTALL. Shuffle 4 assorted defensive basics (1 each: Melanize, Sticky Secretion, Scout Repel, Guttation Cleanse) into your draw deck. Runway for a defensive, attrition build.
flavor: A survival mass packed with every trick, waiting out the siege.

name: Wick Grow
effect: DIRECTIONAL. Grow 2 segments toward the nearest food source lying in a chosen direction, even if out of sensing range, AND drop a tiny lure where they land. Free directed seek.
flavor: A single questing cord, wicking toward the scent it chose.

name: Calcite Surge
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. Gated by Phosphorus. Every tip grows 2 segments toward sensed food and stiffens into structural cord — the P counterpart to the W and N growth spikes, better at holding won ground.
flavor: Mineral scaffolding thrown up across the whole advancing sheet.

name: Mycoparasite Turn
effect: RADIUS around a tap (radius 120), one-shot. Turn the tables: consume every Trichoderma cloud in the radius and gain +4 Energy per cloud devoured (flat). The mould->resource converter. Unplayable if no cloud in radius.
flavor: The parasite parasitised — the colony eats the mould that came to eat it.

name: Stinkhorn Decoy
effect: DIRECTIONAL, one-shot. Grow a reeking false food body in a chosen direction that ant foragers swarm to and waste 3 rounds harvesting, pulling every trail off your real piles.
flavor: Phallus impudicus, stinking of carrion, drawing the insects to nothing.

name: Inkcap Deliquesce
effect: GLOBAL, one-shot. Fully autolyse ALL occupied substrate for +4 Energy per patch (flat) — the biggest ungated burst. Harsh downside: those patches are emptied to zero, killing their passive income entirely.
flavor: Coprinus dissolving itself to black ink overnight, spending everything.
notes: Ungated but the harshest downside (patches zeroed). Balances vs gated bursts.

name: Dormancy Pact
effect: INSTALL. Reduces the SKIP cost by 3 Energy while installed (a cheaper idle). Does NOT print Energy, so it never counts toward the engine ceiling — it just softens the depletion clock.
flavor: Slowing the metabolism to a crawl to wait out the lean dark.
notes: NOT an energy engine (prints nothing); exempt from <11 ceiling. Runway/clock softener.

name: Rhizosphere Priming
effect: GLOBAL. Coax the surrounding soil web for +1 Phosphorus with no rock in range — the free P floor when the crystals are far.
flavor: Exudates sweet-talking the whole rhizosphere into sharing its phosphate.

name: Mycena Glow
effect: GLOBAL. Bioluminesce for one action: reveal all food and rock within an expanded radius so you can plan the next route. Free scouting floor tool.
flavor: Little green lamps of Mycena, mapping the dark by their own light.

name: Ganoderma Bracket
effect: INSTALL. A hard perennial shelf: flat reduction to ALL threat damage each round and slow vitality regen. The cheapest always-on toughness, valuable on any map.
flavor: Reishi, the bracket that returns to the same log for a decade.
notes: Unconditional; defense engine (exempt).

name: Rhizomorph Relay
effect: INSTALL. Shuffle 2 Tropic Lunge and 1 Colonise-Pocket-style Radial Flush basic into your draw deck. Balanced runway of push + fill.
flavor: Relay cords handing the advance from one bundle to the next.
